title: Smooth Third Person Switch
description: Adds a smooth transition when switching to third-person view instead of instantly snapping the camera.
body:
###  **Smooth Third Person Switch**

This **Lightweight** mod adds a **smooth, highly configurable** transition when switching to **third-person** view instead of instantly snapping the camera. It also includes an **option** to **disable** the front-facing third-person view.

### Mod Enabled
![Mod Enabled](https://i.imgur.com/gw2cn6w.gif)
